The Senior Analyst, Financial Crime Compliance is a subject matter expert in the second line of defence, supporting the MLRO in managing and strengthening the Financial Crime Compliance function in the UAE. The role provides expert advisory and judgement on high-risk clients and complex escalations, acts as a strategic partner to Sales, Onboarding, Transaction Monitoring, Legal and Product, and helps ensure adherence to UAE AML/CFT/CPF, sanctions and payments regulations.
q: Minimum 5+ years of experience in a Compliance function in the banking or payments space.
Prior experience in Compliance Advisory is ideal. Otherwise, a combination of 2LoD operations experience with exposure to investigations and audit handling is preferred.

Robust knowledge of financial security topics (KYC, AML/CFT, sanctions) and other compliance topics, including UAE regulatory requirements (CBUAE regulations on retail payment services, card schemes and stored value facilities) and scheme rules (added advantage).
Working knowledge of the UAE regulatory environment. Experience in a CBUAE regulated or other UAE regulated business is strongly preferred.
Clear sense of accountability and a positive, solution-oriented, can-do approach.
Ability to identify inefficiencies, see the bigger picture, challenge the status quo and define scalable and sustainable processes.
Well-organised self-starter, able to prioritise quickly and meet deadlines under pressure.
Strong stakeholder management and communication skills, and a collaborative team player.
Willingness to learn continuously and keep up to date with the payments industry and regulations, local and international.
ACAMS, ICA Diploma or an equivalent certification, and/or a degree in Law or a related field, is desirable but not essential.
